race.comment: SHANTI (11) is the one to beat off a debut third at Hawkesbury where she was beaten narrowly after leading to the turn. First-time blinkers give her a clear chance to rebound from a plain Rosehill run subsequently. The 1350m is new, but she is race fit third-up and has the strongest profile among the main hopes. STUNNING FUTURE (8) resumed with a sound Hawkesbury third, beaten just under a length, and brings the benefit of having already placed at this distance range at Wyong. Gets all the favours from gate one and is a genuine threat. INSAIN CHAOS (5) was ridden a bit closer to the speed then boxed on well for second last time out over 1400m at Grafton. Cherry ripe after three runs back from a spell and the blinkers go on for the first time today which may add that extra edge. DARN SAGA (3) was back from a four-month spell and lining up for only the second time when an impressive third at Hawkesbury recently. Big chance back in a country maiden. SACRED WELL (10) resumes and is next.
